title: A Task-Centric Survey of Long-Document Visual Question Answering: Taxonomy, Evolution, and Future Directions
abstract: arXiv:2610.31385v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable

translated_title: 长文档视觉问答的任务中心综述：分类体系、演进与未来方向
translated_abstract: 视觉文档理解对于从视觉内容丰富的文档中获取知识至关重要，正吸引着越来越多的研究兴趣。现有综述大多侧重于模型架构或技术方法，而对任务瓶颈如何塑造技术选择与研究优先级的关注有限。我们提出了一项以任务为中心的综述，将长文档视觉问答（VQA）分解为四个组成部分：文档解析、证据组织与检索、生成器组织与学习，以及评估。针对每个部分，我们构建了细粒度的分类体系，并梳理了研究动机、技术应对方案以及各组件之间的关联。我们聚焦于显式检索，同时也涵盖直接阅读方式。我们通过时间维度的分析，追踪了研究重点的演进过程：从多模态内容理解，扩展到充分且高保真的证据获取，再到持续的证据管理。我们进一步展望了证据充分性、可验证性等方面的未来研究方向。
tldr: 该论文提出首个以任务为中心的长文档视觉问答综述，将其分解为文档解析、证据组织与检索、生成器组织与学习及评估四个组件，建立细粒度分类体系，并通过时间维度分析梳理研究重点从多模态内容理解到证据获取与管理的演进脉络及未来方向。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a task-centric survey of long-document visual question answering, decomposing it into four components—document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation—with fine-grained taxonomies and a temporal analysis tracing the evolution from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management.
